title: Declared route: support `!=` test filters (the shared placement check reads `!` as a cmd variable)
outcome: A declared test command whose quoted filter uses `!=` (for example `dotnet test --filter 'TestCategory!=Slow' …`) reads, binds and is judged like any other declared command, while built-in placement keeps its behaviour byte for byte.
acceptance: A declared command with a quoted `!=` filter binds to its entry and a passing TRX run records PASS end to end, with a control that fails before the change.
Built-in recognition and placement (engram_check_worktree_in's variable check for `$`, `%` and `!`) are unchanged for every non-declared command, shown by the existing tests passing unchanged.
docs/features/declared-test-commands.md no longer says `!=` filters are not declarable.
